title: Media Bias Detector: Designing and Implementing a Tool for Real-Time Selection and Framing Bias Analysis in News Coverage

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying the differential volume of coverage (number of articles) that different news publishers dedicate to specific categories, topics, subtopics, and events to measure agenda-setting and differential attention.

Using an LLM (GPT-4o) with human-in-the-loop validation to evaluate the emotional slant or tone of news articles on a scale from Very Negative to Very Positive, and extracting sentence-level facts to compare how different publishers present the same events.

Using an LLM (GPT-4o) to classify the political lean of individual news articles on a scale from Democrat to Republican (explicitly or implicitly), which is then aggregated to provide a dynamic, data-driven view of publisher partisanship across various topics.
